title: fix: dashboard provider:object widgets — data-table crash, pivot crash, blank charts
body:
All `provider:object` dashboard widgets broken: charts render blank, data-table crashes with `paginatedData.some is not a function`, pivot crashes with `data is not iterable`. ## Root cause `DashboardRenderer.getComponentSchema()` spreads `...options` into the component schema for table/pivot widgets. When `options.data` is a provider config object (`{ provider: 'object', object: 'opportunity' }`), it leaks through as `schema.data` — a non-array value that downstream components call `.filter()`, `.some()`, `for..of` on. ```ts // Before: provider config object leaks as schema.data return { type: 'data-table', ...options, // options.data = { provider: 'object', object: 'opportunity' } objectName: widgetData.object || widget.object, dataProvider: widgetData, }; ``` ## Fixes - **DashboardRenderer / DashboardGridLayout** — Destructure `data` out of `options` before spreading for `provider:object` table and pivot widgets. Explicitly set `data: []`. - **DataTableRenderer / PivotTable** — Add `Array.isArray()` guard so non-array `data` gracefully falls back to `[]` instead of crashing. - **ObjectChart** — Show visible "Loading…" / "No data source available" messages instead of silently rendering blank when `dataSource` context is missing. - **DashboardGridLayout** — Add `isObjectProvider` handling for charts, tables, and pivots (was completely missing — only `DashboardRenderer` had it). - **Shared utility** — Extract `isObjectProvider()` to `packages/plugin-dashboard/src/utils.ts` to deduplicate across both renderers. ```ts // After: data excluded from spread, set explicitly const { data: _data, ...restOptions } = options; return { type: 'data-table', ...restOptions, objectName: widgetData.object || widget.object, dataProvider: widgetData, data: [], }; ``` 2 regression tests added. 6629 tests pass, 0 CodeQL alerts.
Original prompt > > ---- > > *This section details on the original issue you should resolve* > > [高优紧急] Dashboard 全量 provider:object 场景 Chart/Table 全部空白及 data-table 组件崩溃根因排查与修复 > # 问题总览 > > 合并当前线上 CRM Dashboard 所有 Metric/Charts/Table 全走 provider:object 场景后，线上出现如下重大问题： > > --- > ## 1. 所有图表全部空白，未渲染出任何可见内容 > - 包括 Revenue Trends、Pipeline by Stage、Lead Source、Top Products、Avg Deal Size by Stage、Orders by Status 等所有 widgets。 > - 实际 API/Mock 层含数据，但所有 ObjectChart 均为全白，完全无数据渲染。 > - PR objectstack-ai/objectui#838 合入后问题首次大面积暴露，之前仅 revenue by account 单点白屏。 > > ## 2. table 组件（Recent Opportunities）直接崩溃 > - 出现 "Component 'data-table' failed to render: Me.some is not a function" 的报错，页面卡死。 > - 出错前后 table data 为空或为 undefined，非空数组判定失效。 > > ## 3. KPI/Metric 组件只显示静态，未联动对象数据 > - 之前已知 KPI/metric 仍为静态硬编码，实际业务应走对象聚合。 > > --- > > # 详细排查与技术根因 > > - **ObjectChart 依赖 dataSource 注入**：页面 context 未正确注入 dataSource，Chart 无法获取异步 data，全部跳过 fetch（代码：ObjectChart.tsx, DashboardRenderer.tsx，值为空直接 return）。 > - **table widget dataProvider/data 传递链异常**：DashboardRenderer 走 provider:object 时传 dataProvider, data-table 组件未实现异步场景，导致 data undefined，schema.data/some 报错。 > - **所有 provider:object widget 都未回落/兜底 data-source context**：Storybook 或 CRM Demo 层未传/兜底全局 dataSource，实际页面不可用。 > - **未实现全异步表格渲染**：data-table 必须支持 dataProvider+objectName 异步加载，或 DashboardRenderer 应为 table 兜底转 object-table 或 skeleton。 > - **测试链路未能识别 context 缺失场景**。 > - **数据 pipeline 统一性/���底能力失效**：表组件、图组件、数据 fetch、聚合与 fallback 缺少完整兜底与 graceful degrade，导致全链路失败直接全白。 > > --- > # 建议修复方案 > > 1. **Chart/ObjectChart**：无 dataSource 时显式报错或 skeleton，不 silent fail。Demo/Storybook/context 树必须全路径传递 dataSource。 > 2. **Table/data-table**：实现 provider:object 异步 fetch，或 DashboardRenderer/table widget fallback 至 object-table renderer。无数据应正常 skeleton。 > 3. **DashboardRenderer**：所有 provider:object widget 全覆盖兜底 context/data 注入。 > 4. **KPI/Metric**：可选切换 provider:object 动态数据测试。 > 5. **补充单测+Storybook**：增加 context 缺失、接口异常、长耗时、无数据等极端 case。 > 6. **开发完必须全量运行 test、roadmap 跟进。** > > --- > > # 任务拆分与验收 > - 修复后，全链路全类型场景可在无 dataSource context 情况下输出显式错误或 skeleton，不再全白/崩溃 > - 任何 widget data 为 undefined/null 时均可 graceful degrade，不 fatal error > - Roadmap/test 全部通过 > > /cc @objectstack-ai/objectui-maintainers > > > > --- > Copilot is powered by AI, so mistakes are possible.
